name: 04 Simulated Bidding — Increment validation and bid acceptance

planSteps.description: Navigate to /lot.html?lot=watch and wait for the bid panel to render
Verify current highest bid is '₹2,40,000' and valid bids count is '07'
Clear the bid amount input with id 'bid-amount' and enter '243000'
Verify the bid feedback element displays error message starting with 'Enter a bid of at least'
Clear the bid amount input with id 'bid-amount' and enter '250000'
Verify current highest bid updates to '₹2,50,000' and valid bids count updates to '08'
Verify the bid feedback element displays 'Demo bid accepted in this browser. No real bid or payment has been submitted.'
